name: Hybrid craft
summary: Multi-technique synthesis: combines kinetic headline typography, structured metric comparison cards, and expressive split-screen motion choreography.

forbidden: bounce, elastic or back overshoot on any entrance (R1)
conflicting animation directions between type and data layers
more than three distinct container cards per split scene

frame_checklist: Left and right (or top and bottom) split cards maintain balanced visual weight
Type reveal coordinates with metric reveal without overlapping audio cues
Both safezone side padding (190px right) and bottom padding (460px) preserved
Push transition shifts whole split structure synchronously
licence_notes: Original multi-layer design patterns; no proprietary assets.
